## IMPULSE 0.6.0

This release improves the first-session experience, makes long-term progress more visible, and gives each completed attempt a clearer result summary without changing the deterministic one-tap gameplay.

### Highlights

- Contextual onboarding across campaign levels 1–3 introduces the one-tap rule, chain propagation, targets, and star goals directly in gameplay.
- Tutorial hints automatically disappear as introductory levels are completed and do not interrupt players who have already progressed further.
- Persistent local gameplay statistics track attempts, successful attempts, success rate, total triggered particles, best chain size, and best chain depth.
- Achievements now includes campaign progress, perfect levels, best score, gameplay statistics, and seven local milestone achievements.
- The result screen now shows full chain size, target, maximum chain depth, score, stars, and new-best feedback.
- Additional unit and Android instrumentation coverage validates the new statistics and result flows.
- Android version is now 0.6.0 with versionCode 7.

Existing campaign progress, scores, stars, settings, deterministic level seeds, physics, scoring, and star rules remain compatible with 0.5.0.

IMPULSE remains fully offline with no account, analytics, ads, backend, cloud sync, or Android `INTERNET` permission.

Release artifacts are signed with the existing project release certificate and published with SHA-256 checksums and GitHub artifact attestations.
